tool: installed MAME command line with mame/lua/play-capture.lua
observation: MAME accepts the combined launch and loads the state, but the input recording is not seekable as a suffix: playback reports one frame and no recorded events are applied. Save-state forks must use relative scripted inputs or a dedicated suffix recording.
caveat: The state and input recording are local artifacts and depend on the pinned MAME build and ROM set.
